subject: general
question: Which of the following nuclear plant has the highest capacity?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kudankulam Nuclear Power Plant**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kudankulam Nuclear Power Plant is the largest nuclear power station in India, situated in **Kudankulam** in the Tirunelveli district of the southern Indian state of Tamil Nadu.
 
• Construction on the plant began on **31 March 2002**, but faced several delays due to opposition from local fishermen.
 
• Kudankulam Nuclear Power Plant is scheduled to have **six VVER-1000** reactors built in collaboration with Atomstroyexport, the Russian state company, and Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited (NPCIL).
 
• Thermal capacity is **3,000 MW,** and gross electrical capacity is **1,000 MW** with a net capacity of **917 MW**.
 
• As of the present time on 1st December 2021, the government is considering increasing its capability to **6000 MW**, on completion of KKNPP-3 & 4 (2 X 1000 MW) and KKNPP-5 & 6 (2 X 1000 MW) which are presently under construction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tarapur Atomic Power Station** is located in Tarapur, Palghar, India. It was the first commercial nuclear power station built in India.
 
• The** Rajasthan Atomic Power Station** is located at Rawatbhata in the state of Rajasthan, India.
 
• Madras Atomic Power Station located at **Kalpakkam** about 80 kilometres south of Chennai, India, is comprehensive nuclear power production, fuel reprocessing, and waste treatment facility that includes plutonium fuel fabrication for fast breeder reactors.
